fills.researcher_notes: ONE QUESTION PER COMPANY, answered once for the whole Central Asia-Center system and applied across all 4 rows in this brief (P2291/P2292/P5770/P5771), per the brief's instruction. Established: AO Intergas Central Asia -- a subsidiary of AO KazTransGas/QazaqGaz -- operates the KAZAKH section of the Central Asia-Center system (the brief's transit-corridor guidance: name the entity operating the Kazakh section specifically, not Gazprom/Turkmengaz/Uztransgaz who hold the non-Kazakh sections). Two genuinely independent origins plus one supporting wire report: (1) Intergas Central Asia's own official corporate page (intergas.kz/ru/obwaya-informaciya/) lists the trunk systems its regional Управления магистральных газопроводов (UMG branches -- Atyrau, Aktau, Uralsk) maintain, including verbatim 'МГ «Средняя Азия - Центр» с лупингами'; (2) AO KazTransGas's 50th-anniversary press release on the pipeline (syndicated at nangs.org, same corporate family as (1) so counted as one origin with it) states verbatim 'АО «Интергаз Центральная Азия», входящая в состав АО «КазТрансГаз»' operates the Kazakh section via 7 branch management offices; (3) a GENUINELY THIRD-PARTY, non-Kazakhstani source -- Shamil Yenikeyeff, 'Kazakhstan's Gas: Export Markets and Export Routes' (Oxford Institute for Energy Studies, working paper NG25, 2008), p.32: 'Under the current arrangements with the Kazakh government, Intergaz Central Asia manages the gas trunk pipelines in the Republic and is responsible for transportation, storage and sales of natural gas... Intergaz Central Asia controls the following gas pipelines: - Central Asia-Centre pipeline (for gas volumes from Turkmenistan and Uzbekistan)...' -- confirms the same fact from outside Kazakhstan's own corporate/press ecosystem, so (1)/(2) and (3) count as 2 independent origins overall -> tier=high. Also consistent with an August 2025 Interfax wire (interfax.com/newsroom/top-stories/113443, genuinely independent news source) reporting QazaqGaz completing repair work on a stretch of the CAC pipeline. url_verifier.py: intergas.kz and nangs.org both OK (200, expected substring present).
